title: Words That Change by Country: Transatlantic and Regional Lexicon
goal: Recognize major transatlantic lexical pairs such as carro/coche, computadora/ordenador, and jugo/zumo as equal educated standards

items: I can recognize major transatlantic lexical pairs such as carro/coche, computadora/ordenador, and jugo/zumo as equal educated standards
I can use metalinguistic vocabulary (el léxico, el vocablo, el sinónimo, el americanismo) to discuss regional word choice
I can maintain lexical consistency within a formal text without treating valid regional synonyms as errors
